extracted.name: Creamy Kale Salad
extracted.description: Make this creamy salad dressing for kale with lemon juice, lemon zest, and yogurt to tenderize freshly chopped kale for a vibrant flavor-packed salad.
instruction_lines: Mix kale, red onion, and raisins in a large bowl.

Whisk yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, lemon zest, and lemon juice together in a bowl; pour over the kale mixture and toss to coat. Refrigerate 2 hours to overnight. Sprinkle sunflower seeds over the salad and toss to serve.
